PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THESE APPEALS, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT 1.
The Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation ('KSRTC', for short) as well as the claimant is in appeal.

2. The learned counsel for KSRTC contends that the amount of Rs.4,68,000/- awarded under 'loss of future earning capacity on account of permanent physical disability' is incorrect, since the pay slip produced along with an application indicates that the claimant is still earning the same amount of money as before.

Ramachandra vs The Divisional Manager on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143143030/
2
3. Learned counsel for the claimant contends that the amount awarded by Tribunal is meagre and this is appropriate case for remand.
4. In my view, since the K.S.R.T.C. has produced a final pay slip, it is not necessary to remand the matter.

Since the said document also indicates that the claimant is indeed earning a monthly salary of Rs.25,511/-, the sum of Rs.4,68,000/- awarded under 'loss of future earning capacity on account of permanent physical disability' cannot be sustained and same is accordingly set aside.
5. The claimant, according to the evidence on record, has suffered a disability to the extent of 40% to the whole body and he was hospitalised for more than 15 days.

In my view, it would therefore be appropriate to award a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- towards 'pain and sufferings' and Rs.1,00,000/-
towards 'loss of amenities as against Rs.60,000/- and Rs.25,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
6. The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.77,847/- towards 'medical expenses'.
In my view, since this is based on documentary evidence, the said sum stands affirmed.

7. The Tribunal has awarded Rs.25,000/- towards 'attendant charges' and 'conveyance, diet,
nutrition charges'.
In my view, it would be proper to enhance the same marginally to Rs.30,000/-.
8. Having regard to the fact that claimant has suffered disability to the extent of 40%, it would be appropriate to treat the laid-up period as three months and award a sum of Rs.75,000/-.

9. Consequently, the award of the Tribunal is modified and the following sums are awarded as compensation :

Thus, the claimant is held entitled to the total compensation of Rs.3,82,847/- as against Rs.6,75,847/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till its realization.
11. The K.S.R.T.C. is directed to deposit the amount of compensation awarded within two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

12. As already held by, the Tribunal, the interim compensation amount already paid by K.S.R.T.C.
shall be deducted from the compensation amount and the balance amount shall be released in favour of claimant.
13. The amount in deposit, if any, shall be transferred to the Tribunal forthwith.
14. The appeal filed by KSRTC and the appeal filed by claimant are disposed of accordingly.
